title.description: A string representation of a display title for this content.

emphasisLevel.description: A measure of subjective emphasis on the weight of this material.

attentionLabel.description: An additional presentational label for attention-grabbing purposes.

teaser.description: A short description of the content contained in this document.

eyebrowText.description: String representing a text eyebrow line for a card.

eyebrowLink.description: Link representing an external linking eyebrow line for a card.

isHighPriority.description: Flag representing whether the card should be visually highlighted for priority.

presentationElements.description: Priority-ordered manifest of elements that have been designated for presentation.

brandings.description: The organization(s) whose branding should be used for this document
